datasets.name: PMC / OpenCity published streetlight table (15 wards)
datasets.limitations: Observation year unavailable; reported lights/km and calculated poles/km are shown separately.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo Pune departure forecast
datasets.limitations: City-centre forecast; requires internet and a departure within the returned forecast range. No RSS impact.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap road and pedestrian network
datasets.snapshot_counts: 163,829 nodes; 381,045 directed edges; 831 hospitals; 486 clinics; 79 police; 25 fire stations; 127 street lamps; 590 crossings; 550 traffic signals
datasets.refresh: Rebuild offline before a demo or release; never fetch a graph during a route request.
datasets.limitations: Completeness varies by neighbourhood; tags are not a safety guarantee. No ECB, defibrillator, ambulance-station, or emergency-access-point features were returned by this snapshot, so the UI must report those categories as unmapped rather than fabricate them.

datasets.name: PMC Environment Status Report / ward lighting context
datasets.refresh: Verify against the newest publicly released PMC report before production use.
datasets.license: Public municipal report; confirm reuse terms before redistribution.
datasets.limitations: Ward aggregates do not prove that an individual lamp is working.

datasets.name: Historical crash-risk grid
datasets.refresh: Only regenerate from auditable iRAD / Pune Traffic Police / PMC source records with a dated source file and methodology log.
datasets.license: Source access and reuse must be confirmed with the record owner.
datasets.limitations: The bundled grid is a modelled risk surface, not incident-level public data and not a count of crashes on a street.

datasets.name: Anonymous, corroborated community hazard reports
datasets.refresh: Expires automatically; two nearby independent reports are required for full impact.
datasets.license: Not exported; privacy aggregated to 250 m cells.
datasets.limitations: Reports are not emergency dispatch data. Unverified reports receive reduced weight.

datasets.name: Production data integration backlog
datasets.refresh: Obtain written data-sharing permission and add a reproducible importer before enabling in routing.
datasets.license: To be determined per provider agreement.
datasets.limitations: Do not represent planned feeds as live data. Priority: audited crash records, street-light maintenance, and temporary road closures.
